Effect of revision of prices of coking
and non-coking coal
*221. SHRIMATI JAMANA DEVI
BARUPAL:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
 Will the Minister of  COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Coal India Ltd. has
announced revision of prices of all
categories/grades of coking and non-coking
coal on an average by 16.7 per cent on the
existing pit-head prices;
(b) if so, whether these revised prices
have been effected from middle of June
onwards;
(c) if so, to what extent additional
revenue will be earned by this decision;
(d) to what extent this increase of coal
prices will have an impact on thermal
power generation and steel making; and
(e) whether coal price hike has affected
other essential consumer goods?
Funds allotted under rural
development schemes
*222. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether funds are allotted to the
States for various rural development
schemes; and
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the funds allotted and utilised by various
States under various schemes for rural
development for the last three years,
State-wise?
Allocation of power to Rajasthan from
Hydel Power Projects with Punjab
†*223. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of  POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Central Electricity
Authority/Central Water Commission has
prepared a background paper making a
provision for special allocation for
Rajasthan in addition to its share of Hydel
Power Projects with Punjab;
(b) if so, the comments forwarded to
the concerned States in this regard;
(c) the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Infrastructural facilities for develop-
ment of sports and youth affairs
†*224. PROF. M. M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of  YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up some new stadia and physical training
centres for the development of sports and
youth affairs in the country particularly in
the rural areas;
(b) if so, the amount allocated by
Government during the last three years to
implement the plan formulated by
Government and the details of the amount
utilised out of the above allocation; and
(c) State-wise/district-wise number of
rural youth in the country benefited from
the above plan?
Progress under the Pradhan Mantri
Gram Sadak Yojana
†*225. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise details of the total
amount spent so far under the Pradhan
Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana;
(b) the length of roads constructed so
far; and
(c) the number of villages connected
with roads so far?
Performance of India in the
international sports events
*226. SHRI C. PERUMAL:
SHRI DARA SINGH:
 Will the Minister of YOUTH
AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the performance of our
country in the international sports events
has not been upto the mark compared to
that of other developing countries;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the remedial steps taken to rectify
the situation?
Floods in Assam
*227. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
HOME  AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware
about the latest situation of floods in
Assam;
(b) whether Government propose to
take some effective measures to control
floods in Assam which is a regular feature
particularly in Barak Valley; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Creation of a revolving fund for
weavers
*228. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the weavers of Andhra
Pradesh have requested for creation of a
revolving fund of Rs. 100 crores and another
Rs. 25 crores for maintaining inventory on
yarn etc.; and
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?
Vacant posts in Nehru Yuva Kendras
†*229. SHRI BALAWANT ALIAS
BAL APTE: Will the Minister of YOUTH
AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of vacant posts of

Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of crashes of MIG
aircrafts of Indian Air Force that have
occurred during 2003 and so far during 2004;
(b) the number of civilian lives lost, the

Unauthorised coal minings
784. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many persons
are mining in various coal fields
unauthorisedly;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
financial loss suffered by coal companies/
Government on this account; and
(c) the steps being taken to prevent
unauthorised mining in coal fields?
Shifting of CIL headquarters from
Kolkata
785. SHRI SHANKAR ROY
CHOWDHURY: Will the Minister of
COAL AND MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
shift the headquarters of Coal India Ltd.
out of Kolkata; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
Shortage of coal
786. SHRI B. J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country
is facing acute shortage of coal and now it
is proposed to  import coal from China and
other countries;
(b) if so, what is the current shortage
and its future forecast;
(c) whether it is also a fact that coal
shortage has cut down production of steel
which in turn has increased prices of steel;
and
(d) if so, what is Government's action
plan to tide over this crisis to help the steel
and other industries to raise their
production?
Chalk mining in Uttaranchal
†787. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the large-scale mining of chalk in
Uttaranchal;

CIL dues from SEBs/PSUs
788. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of COAL AND MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Coal India
Limited (CIL) is to recover more than
Rs. 6,000/- crore from various SEBs/PSUs;
(b) if so, since when; and
(c) the steps taken to recover the
amount?
Rates of royalty on coal
†789. SHRI P. K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government of
Madhya Pradesh has requested the
Government of India for reconsideration
of rates on coal royalty on the basis of ad
valorem;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the increase in market price of coal
during the last five years; and
(d) whether rates of royalty on coal have
been increased by 10 to 15 per cent only
over the last ten years?
Fake killings in Siachen
790. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
SHRIMATI SARLA
MAHESHWARI:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that certain
incident of encounters in Siachen are
suspected to be fake;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that officers
involved in the fake encounters were
awarded gallantry awards on account of
these encounters;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the action taken or proposed to be
taken in this regard?
Shortage of men, material and vessels
in Coast Guard
791. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether there is a significant shortage
of men, material and vessels in the Coast
Guard;
(b) if so, whether Government propose
to provide enough men, material and vessels

increased challenges to internal security
posed by the increasing use of sea-lanes
for terrorist movement, gun-running and

(c) whether Government propose to
introduce any advanced technology to
make the Coast Guard function more
effectively and efficiently?
Increase in lower age limit for
recruitment of jawans
792. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Army has decided to increase the lower age
limit of recruitment of jawans from 16 years
to 17.5 years;
(b) if so, how this figure of 17.5 years
has been worked out; and
(c) whether this is being done as UN
Security Council Resolution has
condemned the sending of soldiers below
18 years of age to the combat zone?
Induction of BRAHMOS missile
